players.product: Neocloud GPU compute platform: sovereign AI factories in Australia and New Zealand running NVIDIA B300 / GB300 clusters (GPU-as-a-service, AI platform layers, high-performance storage); NVIDIA Cloud Partner

connects_to.relationship: AI compute capacity supplied to NVIDIA under a six-year strategic compute collaboration (40,000 GB300s, $4.9 billion minimum revenue)

contracts.signal: SharonAI 8-K: the six-year strategic compute collaboration with NVIDIA is governed by a Master Cloud Services Agreement and Order Form 1 dated June 8, 2026 with a contract value of up to $4.88 billion. The companies will enable 72 MW of new data center capacity in Australia and deploy NVIDIA's DSX AI factory design scaling up to 40,000 Grace Blackwell GB300 GPUs; under the revenue-sharing and credit-support model SharonAI sells NVIDIA-powered cloud services and NVIDIA earns standard product revenue and a share of the cloud revenue on the supported capacity, and capacity reserved for NVIDIA may be sold to third parties. The GPU cluster infrastructure is to be delivered and accepted in multiple phases that all terminate on the same date; the agreement sets minimum infrastructure availability thresholds and repair timelines and may be terminated on material breach, including frequent GPU cluster unavailability.
contracts.type: compute capacity agreement (Master Cloud Services Agreement)

quarterly_data.signal: SharonAI 8-K (NVIDIA collaboration release): following the NVIDIA agreement, SharonAI's total AI factory capacity is 132MW, of which 102MW is contracted to end customers, and the company expects to have more than 55,000 total NVIDIA GPUs deployed by mid 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: 132MW total AI factory capacity, 102MW contracted; more than 55,000 NVIDIA GPUs by mid 2027
